Needs changes before merge.

The shared label helper uses the available width. The new tests check wide labels, narrow controls, checkbox clicks, and full-name tooltips. The decision file explains the choice.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `42fd331ff5e1fe5058458bd3ab48d99a623af8d0`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 9 steps passed, including the build.
- UI library: 1,103 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. All four new tests passed.
- `boundary`: 3 passed. `boundary_picks`: 7 passed. `sinker_setup`: 2 passed. `tap_hand`: 3 passed.
- `theme_example`: 3 passed. `theme_files`: 15 passed. `waterjet_tool`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The tests ran from `crates/ui`. The compile cache stopped responding during startup. The local checks passed with the cache disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs:48` — Add before and after screenshots to the PR body for this visible layout change. The body has no screenshots. Show the same property panel and width in each image. Include a narrow panel to show the control clearance. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not commit the images to this PR branch.

Notes:

- This change does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. A safety-tier review is not required.
- No goldens changed. I did not run mutations or pixel snapshot tests. The mutation results in the PR body are the author's results.
- I found no further code blockers. The PR remains a draft while the screenshot request is open.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing before and after screenshots.

The PR body now shows the same Adaptive1 Passes panel at 560 and 260 points before and after the fix. The wide pair shows the full Optimal load label. The narrow pair shows control clearance. All four images are stored only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `2bb21b41501850a58c9ad637b96f05d20594a6f7`.

The screenshot-link check failed on the original body and passed on the updated body. All four hosted images matched their source bytes and panel sizes. Restoring the old form made the property-width, checkbox-width, and narrow-control pins fail. Restoring the fix passed all seven form tests. The quick gate passed all nine steps. UI clippy passed with warnings denied.

Head: `605a8fb9862b77f1124ce7b6480ca6c48a716852` (unchanged; this finding required evidence only). The normal push reported everything up to date. The PR remains a draft.

Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 605a8fb9862b77f1124ce7b6480ca6c48a716852 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This re-review follows the later `Addressed` comment. The head has not changed. The earlier screenshot request is now met.

- All four screenshot links load. I inspected both pairs.
- The 560-point pair shows the full Optimal load label after the change.
- The 260-point pair shows the same panel state and clear controls.
- The images are linked from the fork's screenshot commit. This PR adds no images or snapshot goldens.
- The shared helper preserves compact controls, checkbox clicks, and full-name tooltips. The decision file explains the width rule.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `37bde5e9af529249fb82d0f6a787f9defc74ab1c`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 9 steps passed, including the build.
- UI library: 1,161 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. All four new regression tests passed.
- `boundary`: 3 passed. `boundary_picks`: 7 passed. `sinker_setup`: 2 passed. `tap_hand`: 3 passed.
- `theme_example`: 3 passed. `theme_files`: 17 passed. `waterjet_tool`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Tests ran from `crates/ui` in the review worktree. The inherited cache wrapper stalled at startup. The checks passed with that wrapper disabled. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

This change does not affect posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks. No goldens changed. I did not run mutations or pixel snapshot tests. The mutation results in the PR body remain the author's results. Windows display scales were not checked locally.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
